sources.name: Curiosity REMS (NASA/JPL; CAB, Spain)
sources.note: REMS by Spain's Centro de Astrobiología; outreach feed, not the PDS science product. Sol, air temperature (°C), pressure (Pa); rover location and sampling schedule affect readings. Weather observation date: 2026-08-25; this feed can be archival, not current EVA weather.

sources.name: DONKI SEP (NASA CCMC)
sources.note: Earth-side detection used as a proxy for Mars. Event-start age <= 2 days: alert; <= 7: watch; otherwise quiet (ASSUMPTION). Query covers the last 30 days. Query succeeded; quiet means no recent event start in this catalogue, not a Mars all-clear.

sources.name: Curiosity RAD / Hassler et al. (2014)
sources.note: doseRateMSvDay read from CONFIG.radiation.surfaceMSvPerDay; measured at Gale Crater, the same crater as this dataset. Published baseline, not a live dosimeter.

sources.name: Mars Climate Database (LMD / ESA / CNES)
sources.note: dustTau and evaWindowLocal require manual entry from the MCD interface and team review; no MCD values were retrieved. The manual EVA window is displayed, not enforced.
